reviews.title: Deceptive practices  - BEWARE
reviews.text:
Don’t purchase anything on this app. They are scammers!!
I purchased lifetime access earlier this year. A few months later the app gave me the option to purchase additional access options. I trusted that they wouldn’t have given me these options if I didn’t still need them, so I bought another lifetime access. I reached out to them for help when I realized that I had two lifetime accesses, which is obviously redundant. They acknowledged that the second purchase didn’t give me additional benefits, but repeatedly refused to refund my second purchase and address their deceptive practices. I explained that it was outside of Apple’s refund window, but they still refused to help.

reviews.title: 3 day free trial user
reviews.text: Just 20% of my plants were identified correctly and most had diseases on an incorrect identification.  If I’d be unaware of my plants type, I would have followed incorrect instructions to rid them of their disease.  I tried taking photos of each wrongly identified plant from a different views too, but I would be given other incorrect plants.  The concept is great and perhaps if the monthly price was reduced, it would encourage more users rectifying the mistakes and building up a more accurate database.

reviews.title: Not accurate, poor customer service, such a scam!!
reviews.text:
I signed up for the free trial believing I would be reminded before the trial ended, but I never received any notification. Without warning, I was charged for a subscription I never intended to purchase. Even worse, the charge was processed using a payment method I did not have selected as my active payment option. To top it all off they aren’t even accurate, they misidentified some of my plants, and gave me directs that killed others..their outcome was “give me name of plant we will research it for you”. ISNT THAT THE POINT IF THE APP?! TO IDENTITY PLANT AND HELP WITHOUT THE HASTLE!!

When I contacted support to explain the situation, they refused to issue a refund and simply pointed to their subscription terms. This feels very misleading and unfair, especially when the whole situation could have been resolved easily with basic customer support.

I would strongly recommend being extremely careful with this app and its “free trial.” What seems like a simple trial can quickly turn into an unexpected charge, and the company does not seem willing to help customers when issues arise. I would give this app negative 5 stars if I could!!
